title: FSA-Net: Learning Fine-Grained Structure Aggregation for Head Pose Estimation from a Single Image
metricDefinition: Head pose is a three-angle yaw, pitch, and roll vector estimated for one image; Face-Fit adds a session baseline and answer-level absolute p95.

extractionLocations.description: Head pose defined as yaw, pitch, and roll angles.
Regression objective uses angle prediction error.

measurements.definition: Three-dimensional vector containing yaw, pitch, and roll angles.
measurements.calculationMethod: Single-image regression with fine-grained feature aggregation.
notes: No answer-level baseline-relative percentile is defined.

measurements.definition: Prediction error between estimated and reference pose vectors.
measurements.calculationMethod: Mean absolute error objective and benchmark evaluation.
notes: Measurement error is not behavior quality.

reportedFindings.summary: The paper provides an operational definition of image-based yaw, pitch, and roll estimation.

faceFitMappings.reason: Face-Fit applies baseline subtraction, absolute value, and p95 aggregation absent from the paper metric.

thresholdAssessment.reason: Training and benchmark error values cannot be used as behavioral scoring limits.

limitations: Head pose does not establish attention or eye contact.
Single-frame benchmark performance does not establish webcam session behavior validity.
